features.title: 紧凑成员与重载 / Members and overloads
features.instructions: 筛选 add，一次展开两个重载并比较完整契约。 Filter add, expand both overloads and compare.

features.title: 类型与关系 / Type navigation
features.reason: 关系只展示来源与现有 AST 能力；不推断未知继承。 Relations preserve native partial states.
features.instructions: 从返回类型进入 TextReader，再进入 Readable 并返回。 Follow return type and interface links, then go back.

features.title: 中文 API 契约 / API contracts
features.instructions: 阅读命名参数、默认值、可选数组，并比较 chunks 与 at 的边界。 Inspect defaults, nested generics and exceptions.

features.title: 资源责任 / Resource ownership
features.instructions: 阅读关闭后的异常与调用方责任；这是内存会话，不是文件描述符。 Read ownership and close contracts.

features.title: 指南双向关联 / Guides and APIs
features.reason: 演示精确重载的页面关联，不是完整外置契约合并。 Page association, not full external-contract merging.

targets.concept: 目录与资源入门 / Catalogue and lifetime

features.instructions: 指南进入 String 重载，再通过相关指南返回。 Follow the exact String overload and return to its guide.

features.title: 搜索与发现 / Search
features.instructions: 测试名称与已索引类型字段，观察未知字段和无匹配提示。 Search names and indexed fields; inspect no-match and unknown-field states.

features.title: 实际示例结果 / Doctest results
features.reason: 目前编译后运行或跳过；没有 compile-only/expected-failure 成功模式。 No unsupported mode is presented as passed.
features.instructions: 由结果追到源 @example、输入、退出码和模式。 Trace each result to its exact source example.

features.title: 真实版本变化 / API diff
features.reason: 分类与 comparisonState 完全来自原生 diff；未知语义不补猜。 Native classifications and uncertainty are retained.
features.instructions: 比较同库 demo-v1/demo-v2 的新增、删除、重载与文档变化，打开前后声明。 Inspect native changes and before/after declarations.

features.title: 多版本阅读 / Versioned reading
features.instructions: 按原生身份映射切换版本；被删除成员显示不可用，而不是猜测目标。 Switch common and removed members using the native manifest.

features.title: 质量与缺失范围 / Documentation quality
features.instructions: 核对 audience、各指标分母和具体诊断；百分比不等于正确性。 Inspect denominators, audience and diagnostic source ranges.

features.title: 独立依赖文档 / Independent docset
features.instructions: 区分本地 Stamp 与固定 support-v1 的 SourceLabel 及其成员。 Follow local-first and independent fixed-index links.

features.title: 下载与离线 / Offline and source
features.instructions: 下载源码和完整目录；解压后以 file:// 使用导航、搜索与复制。 Download source and use the extracted offline site.

features.title: 机器可读产物 / Machine-readable outputs
features.instructions: 在 HTML、原生索引、JSON、Markdown 与 llms 输出之间核对同一声明。 Check native identities and routes across formats.

features.title: 边界与诊断 / Boundaries and diagnostics
features.reason: 故意失败、歧义、缺失与跳过单独展示；失败不会被计为通过。 Isolated negative examples retain their raw states.
features.instructions: 查看缺失引用、同名歧义及真实失败/跳过结果。 Inspect unresolved/ambiguous references and raw negative results.

features.title: 本地编写 / Local authoring

targets.concept: 目录与资源入门 / Catalogue and lifetime

features.instructions: 在本地执行 serve；CI 单独验证启动、修改与重建。静态页面不执行编译器。 Run the documented local command.

features.title: 扩展来源与约束 / Extension provenance
features.reason: 只展示源码中的 Entry<String> 约束；不宣传完整扩展适用性推断。 Full applicability inference is not implemented.
features.instructions: 阅读扩展来源与显式 String 约束，不把它推广到全部泛型实例。 Inspect source-backed extension constraints.

features.title: 完整外置契约合并 / Full external-contract merge
features.reason: 当前仅有显式页面绑定，不把它称为完整外置契约合并。 Explicit page bindings are not full contract merging.
features.instructions: 查看已实现的指南关联和明确边界。 Inspect the implemented guide associations and their limits.
